segments.en: The essential wholeness of faith — is to believe that nature is conducted by Hashem Yisburach. And that nature itself is Providence. And one who has this faith in perfection — is able to change nature. For he knows the truth — that there is no nature at all. Only Hashem Yisburach governs His world in this order — that the dry land be dry land and the sea be sea. Which the world calls nature. But through His will He changes this order — and the sea is transformed into dry land. Even the nations who show their faces as friends — their eye is evil toward Israel. And they think evil toward us and prosecute against us. But the boor does not know.
